name: Signal Cluster S52: Regime Change Detection (CUSUM)
description: Tests: cusum(use_std_threshold, std_multiplier, drift). Structural break detection on returns, change_signal output, cusum_pos/cusum_neg leading indicators.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL CLUSTER S52: CUSUM Regime Change Detection
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === RETURNS (CUSUM needs stationary input) ===
rets = returns(close)

# === CUSUM DETECTOR ===
regime = cusum(threshold=5.0, drift=0.0, use_std_threshold=True, std_multiplier=4.0)(rets)
change_signal = regime.change_signal
is_change = regime.is_change_point
cusum_pos = regime.cusum_pos
cusum_neg = regime.cusum_neg

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='CUSUM Positive / Negative',
    category='Regime',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='CUSUM+', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='CUSUM-', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(cusum_pos, cusum_neg))

xy_lines(
    title='Change Signal',
    category='Regime',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Signal (+1/-1)', color=Color.Yellow)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=change_signal)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.ZapIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Direction', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Return', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='Regime Change Point'
    )
)((change_signal, rets, is_change > 0))
